description_en: Manually confirms the release of the next batch
description_zh: 调用ContinuePipeline接口手动确认执行下一批发布
name: ContinuePipeline

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change process. You can call the GetChangeOrderInfo operation to query the ID of the change process that corresponds to a specific batch. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html
parameters.help_zh: 流程ID。可通过GetChangeOrderInfo接口获取1次变更的相关批次的流程ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/62072.html
parameters.name: pipeline_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release the next batch. Valid values:

true: releases the next batch.

false: does not release the next batch
parameters.help_zh:
是否执行下一批发布。
true：执行下一批发布。
false：不执行下一批发布
parameters.name: confirm
